podcast.body: Released in 1994 from the album *A Soap Bubble and a Nersia*, this song was The Gufs' primary hit and received considerable radio airplay. It significantly contributed to their early success as an indie band. "the Gendarvis with pretty much their only hit, but it was a big one on the radio back then. That's first day of spring from the album A Soap Bubble and a Nersia."
